{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Amman East power plant''' (محطة شرق عمان للكهرباء) is an operating power station of at least 400-megawatts (MW) in Amman, The Capital, Jordan.
It is also known as IPP1, AEPP, Amman East (AES Jordan) CCGT Power Plant Jordan.
